data.title: Micron Stock's Drop Triggers 'Buy the Dip' Calls. No One's Listening. — Barrons.com
data.description:
By Adam Clark

Micron Technology stock is well off its highs. That's an opportunity to buy into the memory-chip company before the next round of price increases, according to Wall Street analysts.

The shares were down 3.5% at $899.15 in early trading. Although the price has more than tripled this year so far, it has slumped from its summer peak of more than $1,200.

The recent causes have been fears of memory-chip competition from China's CXMT and doubts about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence boom in general.

But the CXMT-driven fall this week is just giving investors "another reason to buy the memory dip," according to Kent Fung, vice president for market intelligence at Fundstrat. He noted that CXMT's so-called 4F square design could challenge conventional server dynamic random access memory (DRAM), but it is not competition for the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) demanded for AI servers.

"Investors should consider the possibility that the knee-jerk response to CXMT's announcement has been a bit of an overreaction," Fung wrote in a research note Thursday.

"While CXMT's DRAM breakthrough is impressive, it has a weaker association with AI and thus, arguably weaker implications for memory and storage stocks, particularly with regard to their growth potential," he added.

Fung is not alone in his optimism. KeyBanc analyst John Vinh reiterated a $1,750 target price on Micron and called it one of his favorite ideas following a trip to check supply chains in Asia. His findings included that pricing for DRAM in the fourth quarter is expected to rise by 15%-20% from the previous quarter and Google is looking at extending long-term memory-supply agreements through to 2035.

"While we do not believe that the current memory upcycle will extend to 2031 or 2035, this would suggest customers are concerned that the memory shortages are going to persist for an extended period of time and at least beyond 2028," Vinh wrote in a Thursday research note.

data.title: Drilling to Start at Coyote Copper's Arizona Copper Project the First Half of November and 97.7% of the Accelerated Warrants Were Exercised
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 16, 2026) - Coyote Copper Mines Inc.  ("Coyote Copper" or the "Company ") is pleased to announce that it has signed a drilling contract to commence drilling the first half of November.

Warrant Acceleration

As of October 15, 2026 at 4:00 pm the following Warrants were exercised

  • 7,311,901 Warrants with an exercise price of $0.15 from a financing that was completed in July and August of 2025 were exercised.
  • 10,622,351 Warrants with an exercise price of $0.20 from a financing that was completed in January and February of 2026 were exercised.
  • 1,052,152 finder's Warrants with an exercise price of $0.14 from a financing that was completed in January and February of 2026 were exercised.
  • The total amount received by the Company from the exercising of the Warrants was C$3,368,556.63
  • 97.7% of the Warrants were exercised.

The money received from the Warrant exercise will help fund the ongoing and planned exploration program, and fund additional mining claims being staked and acquired.

Exploration Update

  • The previously announced geophysical programs will be completed shortly. Once completed and interpreted, the company shall release the results.
  • Soil and channel sampling continue, results will be disseminated prior to drilling.
  • Drill roads and pads are being built, all necessary permits are in hand.
  • Drilling to start the first half of November. The drill slated for our program is finishing up another company's project, so the exact date for our drilling to start is not known yet.

Dan Weir, CEO of Coyote Copper Mines Inc., stated: "We are very excited to see the drilling begin in approximately 20 to 30 days. The geophysics programs are yielding great results. We completed a site visit at the end of November which 35 people attended including 4 geologists from major mining and fund companies and numerous investors. Having 97.75% of the Warrants exercised, shows that our investors believe in the company, and the work we are doing. I would like to acknowledge all the amazing work that our geologists and geophysical contractors are completing. The large mining companies that have visited the project, have positively commented on the professional work."

data.title: AI Fears Are Rocking Markets. The Brave Should Buy the Dips. — Barrons.com
data.description:
By Alex Rosenberg

In the words of Elon Musk: "Yikes."

This past week, investors questioned some of the core ideas undergirding the artificial-intelligence trade, and the market action got ugly. That could make this a golden opportunity to buy the dip in chips and other AI enablers.

We're not trying to minimize the concerns. The spectacular rise in interest rates — which saw the 10-year Treasury yield hitting 5.36% earlier this month before cooling off — has led to increasing skepticism about the outlook for debt-reliant companies. CoreWeave, which rents out computing capacity to AI model companies, saw the yields on its bonds rise to above 15% (and its stock plunge by about 25% on the week), which earned that "yikes" from the world's first trillionaire.

"This isn't the first time we've had a sizable market wobble on the back of AI fears, but as we move to a capex cycle funded out of debt rather than simply free cash flow, we have to increasingly respect the credit price action," writes Deutsche Bank's Jim Reid.

In other words: a massive amount of capital will be needed for the AI buildout, and higher rates and wider credit spreads will make it that much more expensive for companies to tap the credit markets.

The AI crowd is also looking to equity markets, with OpenAI and Anthropic both planning to go public. But there, too, we're seeing problems. It was reported this past week that Anthropic grew revenue by 45% in the third quarter over the second quarter, which is obviously impressive. But that's down from the triple-digit quarter-over-quarter growth seen in the second quarter, leading to concerns about Anthropic's valuation.

Just as the market was trying to come to grips with AI financing concerns, "the outlined revenue profile of Anthropic underwhelmed, further dampening any AI momentum," writes Evercore ISI's Nicholas Amicucci.

Anthropic and OpenAI support a large share of the AI ecosystem, and they might well make the best AI models. But if other models are nearly as good, then companies and consumers won't be willing to pay up for Claude and ChatGPT. And then who will pay for the data centers and the chips?

So the semiconductors have had a dreadful run, with the iShares Semiconductor exchange-traded fund falling for nine straight sessions to lose 15%. There's no need to send its holders a condolence basket, though, given that the ETF remains 60% higher on the year.

In fact, one of the themes this week has been that the winning stocks have suffered, while the losers have enjoyed a rare moment in the sun. Hated names like Cava Group, Lululemon Athletica, and Nike all rallied powerfully on Thursday and Friday. The consumer staples sector — previously highlighted in this column as the best hedge against an AI slowdown — rose 5% on the week.

As a result, index performance varied wildly. The Nasdaq Composite fell 4.3% on the week, while the S&P 500 lost just 1.9%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average was actually 0.5% higher.

One of the clearest ways to make sense of the action is to look at the iShares MSCI USA Momentum Factor ETF, which tracks the market's best performers. It fell every day of the week, losing 8%, for its worst run since July. Back then, the carnage was precipitated by forced selling on the part of AI-focused Situational Awareness hedge fund — and unconfirmed rumors of another AI-related fund blowing up were getting passed around on Thursday.

The broader point is that the AI winners have become very popular hedge fund holdings, which means that sharp declines can be met with forced selling, begetting further declines. Since such funds generally hedge their exposure, they will pair longs in semiconductors with short trades on stocks like Nike and Cava.

Long/short story short: There are fundamental reasons to be concerned about the AI trade right now, but positioning is running the show.

"Fear is in the air," writes Warren Pies of 3Fourteen Research. "Whether or not it is prudent to reduce risk, this backdrop requires more tactical positioning and an extra dose of paranoia."

Or, as Baird tech strategist Ted Mortonson tells us: "You don't catch a falling knife until it hits the ground and stops spinning."

Mortonson sees tremendous potential in AI and in many of the AI enablers, particularly names like Microsoft and ServiceNow, which help other companies integrate and use AI, and are trading at reasonable valuations. "They already have their hooks into the enterprise, which means the game is theirs to lose," he says.

But he emphasizes that when the selling gets heavy, the wise seek out higher ground.

"Until this market gets rooted back in the fundamentals," Mortonson says, "I'm just buying Berkshire."

It's a sound strategy. But for those readers who have been waiting on the sidelines to buy an AI dip — well, what are you waiting for?

Write to Alex Rosenberg at alex.rosenberg@barrons.com

data.title: Katie Zacharia has been ousted from her role as press secretary – report
data.description:
Current White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia has been ousted, according to three people familiar with the matter, New York Times reported.

Zacharia has been under scrutiny due to how she presented her legal career and how she handled her press briefing. Her role as White House press secretary began on Oct. 12 and has reportedly lasted until Oct. 16.

President Donald Trump was questioned by reporters outside the White House and said, “Maybe the role is not for her.” He mentioned that he told her she did not have to stay in her role.

“I’m going to let her make the decision,” he said. “If I were her, I’d reconsider.”

Zacharia preceded Karoline Leavitt, who served the White House from January 2025 to August 2026.

The White House didn't immediately respond to Seeking Alpha’s request for comment.

data.title: US fiscal 2026 budget deficit rises to $1.99 trillion, largest in 5 years
data.description:
The US budget deficit rose by $217 billion to $1.99 trillion in the 2026 fiscal year, fueled in part by tariff refunds and record spending to service the nation's more-than $40 trillion in debt, marking the largest budget shortfall in five years, Treasury Department figures reported on Friday showed.

The results for the year ended September 30, the first full budget year of President Donald Trump's second term, compared to a $1.78 trillion deficit in fiscal 2025. It was the largest shortfall since fiscal 2021's $2.77 trillion budget gap, then fueled by COVID-19 pandemic relief spending, and is the third- largest annual deficit ever.

Total receipts for fiscal 2026 were a record $5.40 trillion, up $169 billion, or 3%, from the $5.24 trillion in fiscal 2025. Fiscal 2026 outlays also were a record at $7.40 trillion, up $386 billion, or 6%, from the $7.01 trillion in the prior fiscal year.

Debt-service outlays totaled a record $1.36 trillion, climbing by $144 billion, or 12%, a spending category now eclipsed only by Social Security and the combined outlays for Medicare and Medicaid. Total US debt breached the $40 trillion milestone about two months ago.

Another driver of the widening shortfall was a $22 billion drop in net tariff receipts following a Supreme Court ruling this year negating a large portion of the tariffs Trump had imposed during his first year in office. That triggered $145 billion of tariff refunds over this year, resulting in an 11% decline in net tariff income to about $173 billion.

A U.S. Treasury official said the department calculated an estimated deficit-to-GDP ratio of 6.2% for fiscal 2026, but declined to say what GDP estimate was used. This figure compares to an actual 5.8% deficit-to-GDP ratio for fiscal 2025.

For the 2026 fiscal year's final month of September, the Treasury reported a deficit of $27 billion versus a $198 billion surplus a year earlier.

data.title: Novartis halts mid-stage trial for kidney drug, Fabhalta, in lupus nephritis
data.description:
Novartis has terminated a mid-stage trial for its oral Factor B inhibitor Fabhalta (iptacopan) in lupus nephritis, an inflammatory condition affecting the kidneys, because of strategic considerations, according to a federal database on clinical studies.

In an Oct. 15 update, the company said that it was no longer looking for enrollees for the two-part study, which evaluated the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of iptacopan (LNP023) with standard of care in 81 patients with LN.

Approved for multiple complement-mediated diseases, including primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy, Fabhalta generated roughly $505M in sales for the company last year, with over 150% YoY growth in Q4 on a currency-adjusted basis. Endpoints News first reported about the discontinuation.

The Swiss pharma giant has faced a string of late-stage trial setbacks lately, including for its RNA-based therapy del-desiran against a rare muscle-wasting disease called myotonic dystrophy type 1 in September. That came days after another late-stage trial failure for pelacarsen, a heart disease therapy it developed with Ionis Pharmaceuticals .

data.title: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon falls to lowest on record in 2025/26
data.description:
Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon rainforest declined to the lowest level on record in the 12 months through July, data released by Brazilian space research agency Inpe showed on Friday.

  • Some 3,335 square kilometers (1,287.65 square miles) of Amazon jungle were destroyed in the 12 months through July, down about 42% from the previous period

  • It is the lowest deforestation level on record in the historical series that goes back to 1988, the data showed

  • The data is produced yearly by Inpe's PRODES satellite monitoring program

  • The official annual period is measured from August to July as there is less cloud cover in the middle of the year to obscure deforestation on satellite images

  • In Brazil's Cerrado savanna, deforestation fell about 24% in the period, to some 5,517 square kilometers, also the lowest on record — in this case the series goes back to 2001

data.title: Opus Genetics Secures FDA Approval For Eye Drops – Set To Receive Milestone Payment
data.description:
Key points:
  • Ryzumvi contains phentolamine ophthalmic solution 0.75%, which reduces pupil size to improve near vision without affecting longer-distance vision.
  • The approval was supported by two Phase 3 trials.
  • Opus is studying Ryzumvi for vision problems in dim lighting after laser eye surgery.

Opus Genetics (IRD) was in the spotlight on Friday, after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved its eye drop for treating presbyopia, an age-related condition that makes it difficult to focus on nearby objects.

The approval expands the use of an already commercialized therapy and triggers a milestone payment from commercial partner Viatris (VTRS).

At the time of writing, IRD shares were trading 3.4% lower, while VTRS stock gained about 1%.

Approval Based On Two Phase 3 Trials

Opus’ Ryzumvi contains phentolamine ophthalmic solution 0.75%, which reduces pupil size to improve near vision without affecting longer-distance vision. The approval was supported by two Phase 3 trials, VEGA-2 and VEGA-3, which met their primary and key secondary goals without serious treatment-related side effects.

Notably, 27.2% of patients receiving the eye drop saw an improvement of at least 15 letters (three lines) on an eye chart, compared with 11.5% receiving a placebo.

The drug previously received FDA approval in September 2023 to reverse pupil dilation caused by medications used during eye examinations. Viatris launched it commercially in April 2024.

The companies’ licensing agreement dates back to November 2022, when Ocuphire Pharma, which acquired Opus in October 2024, granted Viatris the rights to commercialize the treatment.

The agreement included $35 million upfront, up to $130 million in milestone payments, and royalties.

IRD Finances To Support Operations Into 2029

Opus is developing gene therapies for inherited retinal diseases, including OPGx-BEST1 for Best disease and OPGx-LCA5 for severe inherited vision loss. The company is also studying Ryzumvi for vision problems in dim lighting following laser eye surgery.

Opus reported $88.8 million in cash and cash equivalents as of June 30, and has a financing option of up to $120 million under an agreement with Oberland Capital. The company expects its cash position to support operations into 2029.

IRD, VTRS See Strong Gains In 2026

Retail sentiment surrounding both IRD on Stocktwits flipped to ‘extremely bullish’ from ‘neutral’ over the past 24 hours, amid ‘high’ message volumes. Meanwhile, sentiment for VTRS remained ‘neutral’.

IRD shares have seen strong buying interest so far this year, surging 84%. Meanwhile, VTRS stock has gained about 48%.

data.title: Star Health Brings 'Bishram Grih' and Face Scan Health Assessments to Durga Puja Pandals in Kolkata and Durgapur
data.description:
First-of-its-kind initiative by Star Health offers pandal hoppers in Kolkata and Durgapur a comfortable space to rest and refresh, along with an instant indicative health report covering approximately 17 parameters

KOLKATA, India, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited () (BSE: 543412), one of India's leading standalone health insurance companies, today announced the introduction of 'Bishram Grih' at select Durga Puja pandals in Kolkata and Durgapur. The first-of-its-kind initiative by Star Health offers pandal hoppers a comfortable lounge-style space to "Rest, Relax & Rejuvenate" during their Puja journey. Each Bishram Grih will also feature a technology-led Face Scan health assessment, enabling visitors to gain quick insights into select health indicators.

Pandal hopping during Durga Puja can be tiring, particularly for those visiting multiple locations in a day. At each Bishram Grih, visitors can take a break, sit comfortably and enjoy refreshments such as tea and water before continuing their Puja journey.

A key feature of the Bishram Grih is Star Health's Face Scan health assessment kiosk. Through a simple and contactless facial scan, visitors can receive an instant indicative health report covering approximately 17 health parameters. The assessment provides insights into select vital signs and indicators related to stress, recovery and heart rate variability, including heart rate, respiratory rate, stress index and HRV metrics, among others.

Star Health will set up two Bishram Grihs in Kolkata and one in Durgapur. The initiative will be active from 16 October to 20 October 2026 at the following Puja pandals:

  • Bag bazar Sarbojanin Durgotsav Exhibition, Kolkata
  • 22 Palli Sarodotsab, Northern Park, Kolkata
  • Marconi Dakshina Pally, Durgapur

Operating hours: 11AM onwards

Commenting on the initiative, Mr. Himanshu Walia, Whole-time Director & CMO, Star Health Insurance, said, ""Durga Puja is a festival close to every Bengali's heart, and pandal hopping is an integral part of the celebrations. With thousands of people spending long hours visiting pandals, we wanted to create a space where they could pause, rest and recharge before continuing their Puja journey. Bishram Grih brings this thought to life by offering visitors a comfortable lounge-style space with refreshments at select pandals in Kolkata and Durgapur.

By integrating a quick and contactless Face Scan health assessment into the experience, we are also encouraging visitors to become more aware of select health indicators in a simple and accessible manner. Through Bishram Grih, we hope to combine festive convenience with preventive health awareness and make wellbeing a meaningful part of the Durga Puja experience."

Star Health also encourages pandal hoppers in Kolkata and Durgapur, particularly senior citizens and families with young children, to take precautions during the festivities. These include staying hydrated, taking regular breaks between pandal visits, wearing comfortable footwear and seeking medical advice in case of any discomfort.

Commenting on the regional initiative, Mr. Atin Roy, Business Head - West Bengal, Star Health Insurance, said, "West Bengal comes alive during Durga Puja, with families and visitors spending long hours exploring pandals across the region. Bishram Grih responds to a practical need by offering pandal hoppers a comfortable space to pause, refresh and regain energy. Visitors can also access a complimentary, contactless Face Scan health assessment that provides an instant indicative report covering approximately 17 health parameters. By setting up these facilities at prominent pandals in Kolkata and Durgapur, we aim to make comfort and health awareness a meaningful part of the festive experience."

By bringing together physical comfort and preventive health awareness, Bishram Grih seeks to make wellbeing a meaningful part of the Durga Puja experience. Through such technology-led initiatives, Star Health is exploring ways to complement health insurance protection with solutions that encourage people to remain more engaged with their overall wellbeing.

About Star Health and Allied Insurance:

Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited () (BSE: 543412), one of India's leading standalone health insurance companies, commenced operations in 2006 as India's first standalone health insurance company. Star Health provides Health, Personal Accident and Travel Insurance to its customers. The Company has grown to emerge as one of the preferred health insurance companies in India with several pioneering products and services to its credit. With customer-centricity at its core, the Company has developed superior and innovative product offerings, service capabilities and a seamless claims management process. Star Health offers tailor-made products to cater to needs such as cancer, diabetes and cardiac illnesses, as well as specific segments such as senior citizens, women and children. Star Health is India's first health insurance company to settle over 1 crore claims.

Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd. has a strong multi-channel distribution network of 900+ offices, over 8 lakh agents and robust bancassurance and financial institution partners. The Company has 15,000+ network hospitals and 18,500+ employees.

data.title: Nvidia Stocks Slip 0.7% Although RTX Spark Opens a $2,599 Local-AI Channel
data.description:
Nvidia, the AI-computing and graphics-chip supplier , launched RTX Spark laptops on October 16, with shares trading at $215.7, down 0.7%, at 9:40 a.m. ET. The pitch brings local AI agents and CUDA into premium Windows laptops. The investment test is tougher: can those features persuade buyers to spend more and generate meaningful additional chip sales?

According to Nvidia, six manufacturers are selling systems starting at $2,599. That buys an entire computer; it does not reveal Nvidia's revenue per device. Separately, TechRadar reported configurations with up to 128GB of unified memory, while cautioning that memory capacity alone cannot establish real-world AI performance. Buyers still need software compatibility and enough processing power for their workloads.

The GF Score of 95/100 shows strong profitability and growth, while the much weaker GF Value reading suggests valuation deserves closer scrutiny. RTX Spark could deepen developers' reliance on Nvidia's software ecosystem, but availability alone does not establish demand. Watch sales volumes, purchases of higher-end configurations and sustained developer usage. Those signals would help show whether local AI can become a meaningful earnings contributor.

data.title: HPE Stock's Worst Week Ever Exposes Wall Street's Newest Fear — Barrons.com
data.description:
By Kit Norton

Broader market pressure on tech stocks and concerns around the artificial-intelligence trade are both valid reasons behind Hewlett Packard Enterprise's worst week ever. But an analyst's downgrade revealed a potentially deeper problem for the highflying stock.

HPE has more than doubled this year, rising 134% despite the recent rough patch. Shares declined 4% to $56.24 in Friday midday trading and aredown more than 23% for the week. If the move holds through the closing bell, that would be HPE's worst-ever weekly performance. The last time HPE stock fell this hard was the week of March 7, 2025 when it declined 20%.

Hewlett-Packard Company split into two entities in 2015: HP Inc. and HPE, which makes servers, storage, and other information technology infrastructure.

A stock downgrade earlier in the week triggered the selloff. Barclays analyst Tim Long on Wednesday downgraded HPE along with Dell Technologies and NetApp to Equal Weight from Overweight. The firm lowered its price target on HPE to $77 down from $83.

Long said he was taking a more cautious approach on those stocks. Their valuations have soared this year as sky-high memory costs boosted revenue. Booming demand for AI has led to a memory chip supply crunch and rising costs for memory.

His concern is that the revenue gains for HPE and others reflect higher memory prices more than growing adoption of enterprise AI, a distinction that matters for investors assessing whether the gains can continue.

The analyst added that HPE and other hardware stocks don't appear to have a "meaningful AI inflection" that could produce product adoption, enhanced business performance, and significant revenue growth.

Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring offered a similar assessment Monday, saying higher memory pricing was the main driver of the current hardware cycle.

Woodring said he was "waiting for evidence" of an AI inflection point and that recent surveys suggest accelerated hardware spending was primarily cyclical and not AI-driven.

Wall Street expects increased memory prices to continue into 2027, but the fear is clear. If the shortage ends, future weeks may look even worse.

data.title: American Force Wheels Joins NFI Empire's Project REBORN, Providing Custom Forged Wheels to Support The Brett Boyer Foundation
data.description:
Forged for a Greater Purpose: American Force Wheels Helps Drive Project REBORN's Mission

NORTH EAST, PA / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / NFI Empire, a fully owned subsidiary of Newport Gold, Inc. , today announced that American Force Wheels has joined Project Reborn-001 as a key partner. The custom vehicle build is heading to auction at The Red Bird Games in Brentwood, TN, with proceeds benefiting The Brett Boyer Foundation. American Force is supplying custom forged N33 Barrage DRW wheels that will be wrapped in 37x13.50R22 tires, giving the one-of-one dually its bold, purpose-driven stance.

Rendering of Project Reborn-001, the 1979 Chevrolet K30 crew cab dually, rolling on American Force forged wheels.

The Build Update

Project Reborn-001 continues its transformation of a 1979 Chevrolet K30 crew cab into a modern performance powerhouse, pairing the classic square-body exterior with a contemporary GMC Sierra 3500 frame, Duramax diesel drivetrain, suspension, and amenities. American Force Wheels has contributed its N33 Barrage wheels in 22-inch DRW (dual rear wheel) configuration. The N33 Barrage is part of American Force's forged monoblock aluminum lineup, engineered for strength and reduced weight while delivering the aggressive styling expected of a high-end custom dually. These wheels will be wrapped with 37x13.50R22 tires, completing the truck's unmistakable ground-pounding presence as it prepares for SEMA and its live auction benefiting The Brett Boyer Foundation. Consistent progress updates will continue to be shared as the build advances.

  • American Force N33 Barrage forged wheel mounted with a 37x13.50R22 tire.

  • The N33 Barrage forged monoblock aluminum wheel in a polished finish.

"Project REBORN represents what the automotive community can accomplish when great companies come together behind an even greater purpose," said Jason Sandusky of American Force Wheels. "We're proud to support NFI Empire and The Brett Boyer Foundation and to put American Force wheels on a build that will ultimately help children and families affected by congenital heart disease. REBORN-001 is going to be an incredible truck, but knowing what it represents and the impact it can make is what makes being part of this project truly special."- Jason Sandusky, Marketing / Event / Partnership Management, American Force

"Partnering with American Force Wheels on Project Reborn-001 brings American-made forged strength and style that perfectly complement the performance and purpose of this extraordinary build," said Justin Fried, CEO of Newport Gold, Inc. and NFI Empire. "Every component on this truck exists to amplify awareness and funding for The Brett Boyer Foundation's work against congenital heart disease and in celebration of the Down syndrome community."

What is The Brett Boyer Foundation

The Brett Boyer Foundation is a Nashville, Tennessee-based nonprofit charitable organization founded in 2017 by Ellen and Bo Boyer in loving memory of their daughter, Sadie Brett Boyer, who was diagnosed prenatally with Down syndrome and a congenital heart defect. Sadie Brett may have only lived for 7 months, but her impact has reached countless children and families, ultimately changing the medical industry by providing kids an edge and fighting chance against CHD. Congenital heart disease (CHD) is one of the most common conditions affecting infants and one that remains severely underfunded compared to other childhood illnesses. The Brett Boyer Foundation is dedicated to raising awareness and funding research aimed at advancing treatment options while providing support to families and providers navigating a CHD diagnosis. Another mission of The Brett Boyer Foundation is to celebrate the love, capability, and dignity of the Down syndrome community. 50% of babies born with Down syndrome fight CHD. Through fundraising efforts and partnerships with like-minded organizations both in the Nashville area and across the United States, the Foundation works to improve outcomes for children living with heart disease so that fewer families endure the loss the Boyers experienced.

The Brett Boyer Foundation: https://www.thebrettboyerfoundation.org/

About American Force Wheels

American Force Wheels is a leading manufacturer of premium forged aluminum wheels for trucks, Jeeps, SUVs, and UTVs. Founded with a commitment to American-made quality, the company designs, engineers, machines, and finishes its wheels in-house at a state-of-the-art facility. Specializing in both single rear wheel and dual rear wheel (DRW) applications, American Force is known for monoblock forged construction that delivers exceptional strength, reduced weight, and bold styling. Every wheel is backed by a lifetime structural warranty. Learn more at https://www.americanforce.com/.

NFI Empire (NFIEmpire.com) is the wholly owned operating subsidiary of Newport Gold, Inc., a North East, Pennsylvania-based custom automotive company known for exclusive builds, high-performance vehicles, and deep technical and digital expertise across both traditional and digital automotive sectors. The Company has ceased all mining-related operations; Newport Gold is now a holding company whose operations are conducted entirely through NFI Empire. NFI Empire's stated goal is to become the first publicly traded automotive enthusiast company to integrate a brick-and-mortar business model with a proprietary technology platform.

data.title: KFC Switches From Pepsi to Coca-Cola as Coke Gains U.S. Market Share
data.description:
The beverage giant Coca-Cola Co. (KO, Financials) has scored a symbolic victory in its long-running struggle with PepsiCo.

KFC said it is switching to Coca-Cola products in its U.S. restaurants and expects to complete the rollout to all locations by spring.

TD Cowen thinks the financial impact would be modest, projecting a 10 to 20 basis point increase to Coke's overall revenue in 2027.

But the competitive signal may be more important than the bucks.

Coca-Cola has acquired approximately 70 percentage points of U.S. carbonated soft-drink market share in the previous two years, while PepsiCo has lost around 130 basis points, the business said.

That puts the KFC deal into the framework of a bigger trend, not a one-off contract success.

TD Cowen's take: Coca-Cola and Keurig Dr Pepper have been persistent investors in the U.S. beverage sector, while PepsiCo has been more focused on cost reducing and margin improvement.

Investors doubt if Coca-Cola can maintain translating such investments into share gains.

Next, look for whether other big restaurant or retail accounts defect from PepsiCo.

data.title: Soybeans hit 7-week low, corn down on dry Midwest harvest weather outlook
data.description:
Key points:
  • Drier forecast should speed Midwest fieldwork and Plains winter sowing, Vaisala says
  • USDA confirms 558,000 metric tons of US soybeans sold to China on Friday
  • Black Sea shipping attacks failed to offset broader pressure from technical selling and fund exits

By Karl Plume

US soybean futures dropped to a seven-week low on Friday while corn futures neared a two-month low as dry Midwest weather expected over the coming week was likely to fuel rapid harvesting progress.

Wheat futures slid to a two-month low, on track for a seventh straight weekly drop, as favorable winter crop planting weather in the Plains pressured prices.

Technical selling and long liquidation ahead of the weekend pressured crop markets despite field work delays in many areas this week due to widespread rains.

"Rain should linger in the northeastern Midwest and far southern Plains today, but drier weather is expected in all areas this weekend and early next week. This will favor corn and soybean harvesting as well as winter wheat planting," meteorologists with Vaisala said in a note.

Chicago Board of Trade November soybeans (SX26) were down 3-1/4 cents at $12.59-3/4 a bushel at 12:40 p.m. CDT (1740 GMT) after earlier sinking to the lowest point since August 27. The benchmark contract was on pace for a 2.5% weekly drop despite renewed demand from top importer China.

The US Department of Agriculture on Friday confirmed private sales totalling 558,000 metric tons of US soybeans to China, bringing the confirmed sales total to China to 1.358 million tons over the past three days.

December corn (CZ26) fell 4 cents to $4.74 a bushel after dropping to within 3 cents of a two-month low posted last week when the USDA unexpectedly raised its US harvest forecast. The contract was down about 1% for the week, on pace for a third straight weekly decline.

CBOT December wheat (WZ26) slid to $6.59 a bushel, down 11 cents on the day. The contract, down about 1.8% in the week, has not posted a weekly gain since late August despite concerns about Russian and Ukrainian supplies amid continued attacks on ships in the Black Sea.

data.title: Air Canada, United to Add New U.S.-Canada Routes in Expanded Partnership
data.description:
By Elias Schisgall

Air Canada and United Airlines will add new routes between the U.S. and Canada as part of an expanded partnership between the two airlines.

The Canadian airline will serve flights between Toronto and Louisville, Montreal and Indianapolis, and Edmonton and Newark, as well expand capacity on its route between Edmonton and San Francisco. The new routes are set to launch next summer.

United Airlines will boost its service to Canada with routes from Denver to Ottawa and Quebec City and seasonal service between Newark and St. John's. United also plans to increase capacity on its Washington, D.C.-Quebec City and Denver-Winnipeg routes.

The two airlines also agreed to renew and expand their Transborder Joint Business Agreement, originally signed in 2022. The companies have submitted an application for approval by Transport Canada, the government agency responsible for transportation policies and programs.

"Our schedule has grown every year since our transborder agreement was signed in 2022, and the new routes and flights we're announcing today further underscore our commitment to investing in Canada and making travel between our two countries easier," said Patrick Quayle, United senior vice president of Global Network Planning and Alliances.

More than 4.3 million people have flown jointly on United and Air Canada since the agreement, Air Canada said.

data.title: Coca-Cola, Visa and Mastercard Hit Records as Investors Rotate Out of Chip Stocks — Barrons.com
data.description:
By Paul R. La Monica

Chip stocks have fizzled, but investors are finding fresh highs outside tech. Call it the revenge of the old economy.

Coca-Cola, a quintessential consumer staples stock and longtime favorite of Warren Buffett and Berkshire Hathaway, hit a new all-time high this week. So did Visa and Mastercard, two top financials, as well as life insurance leader MetLife.

Over in the oil patch, Chevron, Shell and ConocoPhillips notched new all-time highs on Friday. Healthcare stocks Gilead Sciences, Thermo Fisher Scientific and McKesson recently hit record highs as well, as did consumer discretionary stocks Urban Outfitters, Williams-Sonoma and SharkNinja. (Chevron, Visa, Gilead Sciences and SharkNinja are all recent Barron's stock picks.)

What's missing? Tech — for the most part. Apple isn't far from a new all-time high. But the shift away from momentum-driven chip stocks, which were surging thanks to expectations of even more big spending on AI by the top hyperscalers, is a sign that investors are largely shrugging off the sector's slump. Chip stocks were on pace Friday to extend their losing streak to nine straight sessions.

"Rotation continues to be the theme," said Michael O'Rourke, chief market strategist at JonesTrading, in a report Thursday. O'Rourke has been vocal about how concentrated the market is but added in his report that it is encouraging to see that the S&P 500 isn't far from its record high despite the notable pullback in chip stocks.

Third-quarter earnings season, which kicked off in earnest this week with several reports from big banks and is set to continue next week with GE Aerospace, Netflix, Meta Platforms, Tesla and Procter & Gamble among the megacap highlights, could be another catalyst for a continued broadening of the rally.

Nicole Inui, head of equity strategy for the Americas at HSBC, said in a report that "unloved sectors," such as financials, and consumer discretionary and real estate could get a lift if companies report better-than-expected earnings and offer upbeat guidance.

"U.S. economic activity continues to hold up better than expected," Inui added. "Earnings leadership could broaden. That, in turn, would support wider participation in the market and an improvement in index breadth."

Valuations also appear reasonable enough to spark a broader rally if earnings for companies outside tech and AI come in stronger than expected. The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF is trading for less than 16 times earnings estimates for the next 12 months, a bigger-than-usual discount to the cap-weighted index.

"Robust earnings growth has remained widespread across the market this year and is even accelerating, which are facts investors may not fully appreciate," said Mike Dickson, head of research at Horizon, in a recent report.

"As earnings come in over the next several weeks, many market sectors may perk up and join the rally. With many stocks below their highs, continued strong earnings growth across sectors could lift more stocks and help the broader market rise in the coming months," Dickson added.

So investors who may be licking their wounds from the recent selloff in chip stocks should take some comfort from the fact that the rest of the market is starting to pick up the slack for semiconductors.

data.title: Mazda and Yazaki First Apply Co-Creation Results for Near-Site and Automated Wire Harness Production in All-New MAZDA CX-5
data.description:
Hiroshima and Tokyo, Japan, Oct 16, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - Mazda Motor Corporation (Mazda) and Yazaki Corporation (Yazaki) have been engaged in co-creation activities since early 2022 aimed at bringing wire harness production closer to vehicle assembly plants and advancing automation, with the goal of building a resilient supply chain and realizing sustainable manufacturing. Transcending the traditional boundaries between an automaker and a parts manufacturer, the two companies combined their expertise and technologies from the early stages of development. As the first outcome of this collaboration, wire harnesses produced through this new production method have been adopted for the first time in the all-new MAZDA CX-5.

Wire harnesses are critical components that distribute power and transmit data throughout vehicle systems. To accommodate differing vehicle specifications, a large number of wires and terminals must be combined, and many manufacturing processes are still performed manually. In addition to challenges associated with inventory management and increasingly complex production and logistics operations resulting from a growing variety of parts, manufacturers have also needed to respond to changes in the business environment.

To address these challenges, the two companies focused on near-site production, where by finished products are manufactured close to vehicle assembly plants, and on the automation required to achieve it. While near-site production contributes to supply stability, greater efficiency in production and logistics, and reduced environmental impact, achieving competitive manufacturing remains a key challenge. At the same time, wire harness production involves many delicate and complex manual processes, making automation difficult to achieve through equipment installation or robotic automation alone.

To overcome this challenge, the two companies collaborated from the early stages of vehicle development and reviewed wire harness variants, specifications, structures, and manufacturing processes with automation in mind. By simultaneously redesigning products and production processes, they improved manufacturing capability and operational efficiency, enabling more competitive manufacturing. Furthermore, through optimization of the entire vehicle, including these initiatives, the number of wire harness variants used in the all-new MAZDA CX-5 was reduced by approximately 80% compared with the previous-generation CX-5.

As a result, the two companies established a production and supply system under which component parts procured by Yazaki are assembled into finished wire harnesses at a Yazaki affiliate's plant in Mine City, Yamaguchi Prefecture, and delivered to Mazda plants in Hiroshima and Yamaguchi prefectures. The system enables domestic production to respond flexibly to fluctuations in demand and changes in the external environment, while improving efficiency and resilience across the entire supply chain. The companies also aim to support the sustainable development of regional manufacturing capabilities while fostering the next generation of talent and preserving manufacturing skills and expertise.

Both companies plan to apply the knowledge gained through this co-creation initiative to wire harnesses used in future vehicle models. Through stable supply, improved production and logistics efficiency, and reduced environmental impact, they will continue their efforts to realize a highly competitive supply chain and sustainable manufacturing.

Comment by Kazuhiko Sumi, Corporate Leadership Executive Officer and CSCO, Mazda Motor Corporation

This initiative embodies the supply chain structural transformation and "Mazda Manufacturing Innovation2.0" outlined in our 2030 Management Policy. Through proactive co-creation with our business partners, we have combined expertise and manufacturing capabilities to reduce component variants, bring production closer to vehicle assembly sites, and advance automation. These efforts have strengthened both our cost competitiveness and our ability to respond to change, helping us achieve more competitive manufacturing. We will not limit the application of these achievements to the all-new "MAZDA CX-5." We will also leverage them to support the development of regional manufacturing capabilities and the transfer of technologies and skills to future generations. Together with our partners, we will continue creating new value for our customers.

Comment by Kunio Tsuyuki, Senior Managing Director, Yazaki Corporation

This initiative reaffirmed my belief that when companies share the common goal of delivering greater value to customers, auto makers and suppliers can combine their expertise and technologies beyond traditional organizational boundaries to create new sources of competitiveness. In particular, our efforts to advance automation are not simply about reducing labor requirements or lowering costs. They are important initiatives that contribute to stable quality, higher productivity, skills transfer, and ultimately sustainable manufacturing. Through continued co-creation with Mazda, we will further advance manufacturing innovation and supply stability while delivering safe, reliable, and high-quality products to our customers.

Source: Mazda

data.title: Meta Stocks Slip Although Muse Reaches Seven Inference Platforms
data.description:
Social-media and AI developer Meta Platforms expanded access to its AI technology with Muse Spark Open, while shares traded at $730.445, down approximately 0.85%, at around 10:04 a.m. ET on October 16. Developers now have more ways to use Meta's models outside its apps. The investment question is straightforward: how does wider adoption turn into earnings? The release does not quantify its expected revenue contribution.

Meta's announcement lists seven hosted-inference partners and describes a model with 816 billion total parameters, 42 billion active parameters and a one-million-token context window. Meta says it can also run on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios. Downloadable weights give developers more control, but the company's license terms place limits on commercial use. Wider access does not mean unrestricted access. And while active parameters represent roughly 5.1% of the total, that ratio alone says little about actual operating costs.

The valuation snapshot puts Meta 15.75% below its $866.96 GF Value estimate, suggesting potential upside if the assumptions behind that estimate hold. That gap is a valuation signal, not a guaranteed return. For shareholders, the next checkpoints are developer adoption, commercial agreements and measurable improvements in Meta's products. Getting the model into more hands opens doors. Turning that reach into profitable growth is the harder test.

data.title: Meta Muse continues to see increased adoption, though overall rates are low: BNP
data.description:
The strong interest in Meta Platform's Muse artificial intelligence agent does not seem to be slowing down, BNP Paribas said on Friday.

Citing third-party data analysis, the investment firm said the app, which overtook OpenAI's ChatGPT at the top of the App Store, has generated more than 10.4M downloads so far, BNP analyst Nick Jones said in a note to clients. Downloads peaked on day 12 of the release and have since stabilized in an upward trend, the analyst added. Jones has an Outperform rating and an $885 price target on Muse.

“While Muse Wonder is mainly targeting enterprises and developers, it will also power Meta Muse, initially for paid subscribers, which could help increase adoption and engagement,” Jones wrote in a note to clients. “Compared with other AI platforms, Muse’s early U.S. downloads surpassed Sora and ChatGPT, which is not surprising given its massive install base for Instagram, WhatsApp, and Facebook.”

Delving deeper, Jones said engagement for Muse is still early, and users are "predominantly" men, and younger people have “relatively low adoption” of the app. As such, it's unlikely to be a threat in the near-term to vertical marketplaces due to “still-nascent” adoption and a few other issues.

“In terms of monetization, as of now, Meta is charging partners small transaction fees. Muse is free for the basic tier and offers monthly subscriptions for higher usage to maximize adoption and engagement,” Jones added. “But we believe long-term monetization remains a question mark for investors—we see a path where advertising could be compelling as engagement builds.”

Events that investors will need to pay attention to include how well OpenAI's Dots (which is believed to be geared towards the enterprise) does, as well as when other companies such as Google , SpaceX , and others launch their AI agents, Jones added.
